title: Unplug Before Connecting
prompt: What should you do first before connecting the DVD player?
hint: Turn off the power and unplug the TV before touching any cables.

ja.prompt: DVDプレーヤーを接続する前に最初に何をしますか？
ja.hint: ケーブルに触る前にテレビの電源を切り、プラグを抜いてください。
ja.sample: テレビの電源を抜きます

prompt: Where do you connect the black plug?
hint: It goes into the back of the television; plug it into the TV.

title: Clean Behind the TV
prompt: After connecting the plugs, what should you do before pushing the TV back?
hint: Remove dust and dirt first; clean the space behind the television before pushing it back.
sample: Clean the area behind the television first
